checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: All items removed from counters, sink and stove.

must.item: Original brown cabinets and beige tiles remain
must.why: Cabinets and tiles are the same, slightly warmer/cleaner.
Same camera angle and layout. The stove was converted from a sink-like basin to burners, and a glass panel appeared on the left counter.

must.item: Cleared areas continuous and natural, no erasure marks
must.why: Counters look smooth and natural. The glass cooktop-like panel on the left is an odd leftover.

faults.what: The right-hand basin (a second sink) was replaced with a stove top with burners, changing a fixed fixture.
A grey glass-like panel on the left counter is an invented or leftover object (it was the cutting board).
The counters were recolored to a clean cream, and the faucet on the right was removed.

summary: The kitchen is tidy and keeps its cabinets, tiles and viewpoint, but the right-hand sink basin turned into stove burners and a strange glass panel remains on the left counter.
